draft.hook: Nov in Bengaluru finally feels like a vibe 🍂
draft.body:
The weather is actually pleasant rn — around 65°F to 83°F — and we’re here for it.

That’s why we’re launching our new Masala Chai Cold Brew. Black tea, cardamom, cinnamon, and ginger, all cold-brewed and served over ice.

No added artificial syrups, just the chill vibes and that classic masala kick. Cold brew methods are gaining popularity for teas, aur yeh perfect way hai is flavour ko enjoy karne ka.
draft.call_to_action: Drop by our Indiranagar cafe to try it, or DM us to place an order ☕
draft.image_idea: A close-up shot of the Masala Chai Cold Brew in a glass with ice, garnished with a cinnamon stick and cardamom pod, set against the cosy interior of the Indiranagar cafe.
